items.instruction: Independently play the exact final candidate continuously from first frame to final frame at 1.0x without skipping, scrubbing, or fast playback.
Confirm this review is performed by a named reviewer different from the claims-and-source-pass reviewer.
Confirm basename, artifact ID, run ID, byte count, and SHA-256 identify the same candidate used by the bound probe, claims audit, first review, and run manifest.
Confirm the bound probe reports one H.264 yuv420p 1920x1080 video stream, one AAC 48000 Hz stereo audio stream, and a positive duration below 1200 seconds.
Confirm picture and sound are continuously present and synchronized with no black frames, unintended freezes, corrupt frames, dropouts, clipping, or explosive level changes.
Confirm the first frame, final frame, all ten chapter starts and ends, and every declared internal boundary enter and exit cleanly.
Confirm Simplified Chinese remains the primary visual layer and synchronized English remains secondary; each language uses at most two readable lines inside the 1920x1080 safe area.
Confirm subtitles, lower thirds, chapter cards, and continuity labels do not cover identities, values, revisions, branches, incident states, cycle markers, or postconditions.
Confirm the institution and multi-person organizational network remain the narrative subject; the cut does not collapse into a single-official recovery or revenge story.
Confirm edits, reprises, match cuts, narration, music, and sound effects do not imply unproved continuity, causality, success, settlement, closure, or cross-cycle persistence.
Confirm no fixture, test, debug, ZGA, acceptance, launcher, loading, generated substitute, prohibited name, crop, mask, blur, redaction, or redrawn product UI appears.
Confirm the finale states People transfer; the ledger remains, lists only real included spans, and does not claim COMPLETE, release-ready, exported, or published status without matching evidence.
Confirm the automated claims audit is passed, its manual sign-off is genuinely approved for these bytes, and every issue from the first review is closed without changing the candidate afterward.
